# pvecli sdn apply

Apply the pending SDN configuration on every node of the cluster.

On PVE 9.2+ the network and FRR changes are previewed first, and the
global SDN lock is taken for the duration of the apply, so a concurrent
edit from the web UI or another tool cannot slip in between.

```text
pvecli sdn apply [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `-f`, `--force` |  | Re-apply even when nothing is pending, to regenerate the node configuration. |
| `--diff` / `--no-diff` | `--diff` | Show what the reload changes on a node first (PVE 9.2+). |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Skip the typed confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |
